stories.title: U.S. Army plans to carry out detonation at Iowa plant on Wednesday despite indefinite pause
stories.summary: The Department of the Army said it plans to use an emergency munitions and explosives exclusion to the Environmental Protection Agency's permit.

stories.title: Tom Jackson, former Denver Broncos star and sports broadcaster, dies at 75
stories.summary: Tom Jackson, a former Denver Broncos player and ESPN analyst, has died at 75.

stories.title: U.N. COP31 climate conference ends with no agreement after fossil fuel debate reaches standstill
stories.summary: COP31, the latest installment of the United Nations' annual climate conference, ended Sunday without a final agreement after days of contentious talks collapsed.

stories.title: Delta Air Lines experiencing nationwide delays after baggage network system issue
stories.summary: The Delta Air Lines delays are most impacting flights in and out of Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport in Georgia.

stories.title: Detroit man sentenced for 5-year identity theft and credit card fraud scheme
stories.summary: A Detroit man was sentenced to five years in prison for a five-year identity theft and credit card fraud scheme, the United States Attorney's Office for the Eastern District of Michigan announced.

stories.title: Nearly 150 aboard cruise ship sickened by unknown stomach illness
stories.summary: Nearly 150 passengers and crew aboard a cruise ship that departed from South Florida last week have reported becoming ill with a stomach illness, the CDC says.

stories.title: Clouds clear as temperatures drop overnight
Lions beat Buccaneers 31-21 as Jared Goff throws 2 TDs
stories.summary: Jared Goff threw two touchdown passes through three quarters, and Jahmyr Gibbs ran for two scores in the fourth, helping the Detroit Lions pull away and beat the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 31-21 on Sunday.

stories.title: Farmington Civic Theatre upgrades include new seats and liquor license
stories.summary: The manager says crowds are picking up after the historic Farmington Civic Theatre made some upgrades, including new seats and a liquor license.

stories.title: Drivers excited to drive on I-696 after nearly two years of construction
stories.summary: Eastbound I-696 is back open after closures due to a massive construction project, and drivers in the Metro Detroit area couldn't be happier.
